verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs describe a Modeler Agent that builds and maintains planning models from natural-language intent and an Analyst Agent that builds reports from conversations. Its MCP server also lets users build, edit and query models through Claude, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on which commands and operations the agents cover (the evidence is marketing-level), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Modeler Agent builds, maintains, and optimizes planning models from natural language intent.
Build and edit your Pigment model directly from tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex, without switching interfaces.
teams can ask questions of the business in ChatGPT or Claude and get accurate answers grounded in your business truth.
